verdict.rationale: Synthesia's Video API generates scripted avatar videos (docs-15) and accepts uploaded custom script audio for those videos (docs-16), with avatars built from a photo or in stylized forms (docs-2, docs-3). Lip-sync is explicitly claimed, but the 'perfect lip-sync' wording appears in the video-translation context (docs-6). One user called a Synthesia presenter 'twitchy, hesitant, uncanny' (comm-1), which is general realism criticism rather than a concrete lip-sync failure. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of lip-sync accuracy for scripted or custom-audio avatar dialogue, independent hands-on corroboration of lip-sync quality.
